meals.name: Paneer & Quinoa Power Bowl
meals.desc: Protein-rich bowl with spiced paneer and fresh greens
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin, then paneer cubes; sear until golden.
Toss in tomatoes and spinach until just wilted.
Serve over warm quinoa, season to taste.

meals.name: Coconut Chickpea Curry
meals.desc: Creamy, fragrant curry with chickpeas and coconut milk
steps: Sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Stir in curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer 15 min.
Fold in spinach, serve over rice.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu Stir-Fry
meals.desc: Quick wok-tossed tofu with crunchy vegetables
steps: Pan-fry tofu until crisp on all sides.
Remove tofu, stir-fry vegetables with garlic and ginger.
Return tofu, add soy sauce and sesame oil.
Toss 2 minutes and serve hot.

meals.name: Hearty Red Lentil Soup
meals.desc: Warming, fiber-rich soup, gentle on the stomach
steps: Sauté onion and carrot in olive oil.
Add turmeric, lentils and stock.
Simmer 25 minutes until lentils break down.
Blend lightly, finish with a squeeze of lemon.

meals.name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
meals.desc: Lean grilled chicken with a bright herb marinade
steps: Whisk lemon, oil, oregano and garlic.
Marinate chicken 15 minutes.
Grill 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Rest 5 minutes, serve with salad.

meals.name: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowl
meals.desc: Omega-3 rich salmon glazed and served over rice
steps: Brush salmon with teriyaki sauce.
Pan-sear 4 minutes per side.
Plate over rice with avocado and broccoli.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve.

meals.name: Mediterranean Turkey Wrap
meals.desc: Light wrap with lean turkey, hummus and crisp veg
steps: Spread hummus over the tortilla.
Layer turkey, vegetables and feta.
Add greens and roll tightly.
Slice in half and serve.

meals.name: Roasted Veggie Buddha Bowl
meals.desc: Colorful roasted vegetables over grains with tahini
steps: Roast sweet potato and chickpeas at 200°C for 25 min.
Massage kale with a little olive oil.
Assemble rice, roasted veg and kale.
Drizzle with tahini and serve.
